answer: Think of each identity as a tree in an orchard: it takes time to grow, bear fruit, and be recognized by neighbors. A beacon that publishes an agent's work history makes that growth visible, and a vault lock ties the identity to a real cost. Sybils are saplings with no history, no fruit, and no lock, so they cannot claim the standing of a mature tree without paying the same time and cost, which makes mass creation uneconomical.
